label: Confirmed measles deaths
source: CDC / Texas DSHS / New Mexico DOH / Pennsylvania DOH / Lancaster County Coroner — 2 children (TX) + 1 adult (NM) in 2025, all unvaccinated; 2 unvaccinated Lancaster County, PA infants in Aug 2026 (both excluded from CDC's national tally in Sept 2026 at HHS Secretary Kennedy's request)
contestNote: Lancaster County Coroner Dr. Stephen Diamantoni ruled Sept 9, 2026 that measles killed 6-week-old Mary Stoltzfus, but that newborn Ivan Miller's death was an unrelated ruptured spleen. Pennsylvania still classifies both as 'measles-associated' (positive test, regardless of immediate cause), while CDC's federal tally excludes both.
deltaNote: Coroner determination narrows the state's 2 'associated' PA deaths to 1 medically-confirmed measles death; CDC's federal tally is unchanged at 3 (2025 only)
